published_source: Authors' code output (FoodDeliver.R, Table 4) re-run on the shipped data; no article text available. Mobility control coefficient reported in the same regression.
replication_status: exact (authors' code output; article not available to compare)
notes: Table 4 of FoodDeliver.R (lfe::felm(log1p(y) ~ onplatform_weekly + community_mobility_weekavg | Week_Num + rest_numericID | 0 | rest_numericID)). Restaurant-week panel, 53 weeks (2018-12-31 to 2019-12-30; Week_Num is week-of-year in a single year, so it is calendar time), unbalanced. Treatment onplatform_weekly = restaurant has joined any on-demand delivery platform; absorbing (0 switch-offs). Only protocol violation: the time-varying county-by-week mobility control community_mobility_weekavg (PROTOCOL 5c). No weights; clustered by restaurant. PUBLISHED COEFFICIENT = AUTHORS' CODE OUTPUT: no article text or PDF in the project; published_coef/se are from re-running the authors' felm call on the shipped fooddeliver.dta (fixest gives the same point estimate to 6 decimals). Column numbers are inferred from the code order (before-matching takeout, dine-in; after-matching takeout, dine-in) and must be checked against the article PDF. Matched subsample (matched == 1, sample restriction under PROTOCOL 5b): 2,964 restaurants, 1,991 never treated, 4 always treated, 969 switchers over 49 adoption weeks. preferred and in_abstract_intro set to null: unknown without the article text.
